work.author: Pietro Bembo
work.title: De Aetna ad Angelum Chabrielem liber
work.date_verification: The Biblioteca Nazionale Marciana exhibition explicitly distinguishes the historical imprint date from February 1496. The BNCF copy's original colophon agrees with the historical date.

selected_holding.server_provenance: The successful file server and directory are explicitly listed in the public archive metadata and BookReader URL. The initial archive.org download redirected into an SSL connection timeout, not an access denial.
selected_holding.page_number_caution: PDF page numbers are one-based scan positions, not printed page numbers or leaf signatures. Do not call PDF10 printed page10.
selected_holding.identity_check: Opening title names Petri Bembi De Aetna; the colophon names Aldi Romani, Venice and February. Both images carry the same Ald.1.1.40 shelfmark footer. This is neither the 1530 edition nor the Mardersteig1969 revival.

preservation.extraction: Exact raw /DCTDecode JPEG stream bytes from PDF10 /Im10 and PDF69 /Im69, respectively. No Pillow image save, resampling, recompression, color adjustment, AI generation or redrawing was used for the archived selected JPEGs.
preservation.verification: Both selected JPEG byte strings were asserted equal to the corresponding raw PDF image streams after copying.
preservation.selected_image_quality: Readable full-resolution historical type and unaltered paper, stains, stamps and scan footer. Final booklet-size readability has not been assessed.

caption_proposal_without_figure_number: Pietro Bembo, De Aetna, Venezia, Aldo Manuzio, febbraio 1496 (1495 more veneto). Pagina iniziale. BNCF, Ald.1.1.40; Early European Books / ProQuest, 2010, via Internet Archive.

alternate_primary_source.visual_limit: The published PDF shows severe green/pink/brown posterisation over paper in the inspected opening and colophon. A native Poppler rendering of PDF1 independently confirms the opening's artifacts; they are not a pypdf extraction or recompression error. Prefer the BNCF source for clarity; do not recolor the Marciana scan to hide them.
alternate_primary_source.holding_caution: The exhibition describes two Marciana copies; this audit did not establish which physical shelfmark the linked PDF reproduces.

rejected_candidate.reason: The item record says February1496, but the actually linked image visibly reads Verona MCMLXIX and includes Pietro Bembo / On Etna. It is the 1969 Mardersteig edition, not the required historical original. The historical-looking file name is not evidence of authenticity. DO NOT IMPORT this image as1496.
